Tidy a VAR Model

Source: R/tidy.R
tv_tidy.Rd

Tidier for the varest class.

Usage

tv_tidy(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
tv_tidy(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'varest'
tv_tidy(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of the varest class.

...

Additional objects to be pass through. Currenttly not used.

Value

A tibble.

Examples

model <- vars::VAR(EuStockMarkets)

tv_tidy(model)
